$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-tool-call or .ds-tool-call-group). In a group, the call paths are the first row's.

Details.$why: Figma draws the rule above the details as a separate 1 px Separator; the code draws it as the details' top border, so they are 1 px taller (the card's size is compared).

Code.$why: Figma stacks code lines 2 px apart inside 8 px padding; the code's <pre> uses a 2 px taller line and 1 px less padding, which puts every line in the same place (the box's size is compared).

Code/TEXT.$why: Figma stacks code lines 2 px apart inside 8 px padding; the code's <pre> uses a 2 px taller line and 1 px less padding, which puts every line in the same place (the box's size is compared).

Waiting.$why: Figma puts a Waiting row inside the Code box; in code the box itself is the waiting row (its gap is compared, the box's place and size come from the card's size).
